sources.claim: LC-39B is the launch complex used for SLS Artemis missions.
Approximate historical LC-39B coordinates used for the in-game globe.
Real launch weather constraints include wind, precipitation, temperature, and lightning; 0-to-1 game risk values are fictional.
Orion supports a crew of four; reference materials discuss missions lasting up to 21 days.
Reference SLS Block 1 and Block 1B payload capacity to translunar trajectories: 27 and 38 metric tons.

definitions.REAL_FACILITY: A real location identified in NASA sources; names and approximate coordinates are used.
definitions.FICTIONAL_GAME_DESIGN: Names, biographies, skills, events, probabilities, and scores created for the game.
definitions.SYNTHETIC_EDUCATIONAL_SCENARIO: Invented 14-day weather risks, wind and cloud data used to test the calendar; not measurements or forecasts.
definitions.GAME_MISSION_BASE: The team's educational Artemis V13 mission with a four-person crew and 12-day duration; not an actual Artemis II flight.
